constants.admission: finite crop origins; positive valid dimensions; finite nonnegative tolerance; boolean words0/1; reserved0; exactly matched resource formats/extents; host must not infer positive-depth semantics from values alone

srvs.name: CurrentNormalRoughness
srvs.role: owned original bridge normal/roughness, before Flat Albedo; all packed words preserved

srvs.name: CurrentDepth
srvs.role: original bridge linear depth, same signed convention/scene units as motion B; temporal admission restricted to proven positive-linear convention

srvs.name: CurrentMotion
srvs.role: live: original bridge pre-G3 motion; captured replay: actual provider motion with separately declared authority. Physical full-render UV RG and previous-minus-current linear-depth B; W read-only. These authorities are not silently interchangeable.

srvs.name: PreviousNormalRoughness
srvs.role: immutable previous original guide snapshot with exact lineage

srvs.name: PreviousDepth
srvs.role: immutable previous depth snapshot; same positive-linear semantic convention when admitted

channels.G: 3x3 relative depth span; saturates positive overflow to FLT_MAX, invalid to0
channels.B: weighted all-four-point-tap angular innovation,0..2, zero unsupported
channels.A: experimental cosine multiplier,clamp(1-B,0,1), identity1 unsupported; display/proxy only

bits.0: CURRENT_FINITE: finite positive current depth + decoded finite normal
bits.1: SPATIAL: current valid and at least3 finite positive neighbors in3x3
bits.2: MOTION_FINITE: finite current motion XYZ, no W interpretation
bits.4: IN_PREVIOUS_CROP: entire four-tap footprint exists before integer cast
bits.5: CATEGORY_MATCH: all four original categorical codes equal current, including zero-weight taps
bits.6: DEPTH_MATCH: all four positive finite prior depths agree with finite positive d+motionB, and both depth conventions proven
bits.7: TEMPORAL_SUPPORTED: numerical observed-field comparison support, not physical layer/history validity

unsupported_temporal.production_behavior: unchanged; do not install a history gate
unsupported_temporal.spatial_observation: retained when spatial evidence is available

coordinate_contract.units: original full-render pixels, crop origin x/y
coordinate_contract.sampling: four explicit point Load calls with continuous bilinear weights; no hardware sampler or fraction quantization
coordinate_contract.support: all four in crop and satisfy category/depth even at zero weight

semantics: Angular variability cannot identify coverage mixture versus valid fine geometry, wrong transport or unrelated lighting noise. No AMD binding or production confidence is proposed.
raw_depth_validity_and_coverage: not inputs to v1; absent evidence cannot be inferred from finite/clamped depth or angular coherence

source_authorities.temporal_pair_rule: every per-role authority must match between frames; e.g. glass prepared normal observations cannot join pre-Flat history
